arguments.summary: A Golden Ticket attack was confirmed following the compromise of the krbtgt account hash via DCSync (Event ID 4662) from source IP 10.0.5.14 to domain controller 10.0.1.10. The attacker achieved domain-level privilege escalation and could forge valid Kerberos tickets for any user or service. Evidence indicates lateral movement from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), including Cobalt Strike beaconing to external C2 infrastructure. Despite detection, containment actions (domain-wide credential revocation, firewall isolation) were denied due to invalid parameters or lack of approval. The domain remains at critical risk until krbtgt password is reset twice and all Kerberos tickets are invalidated.

}
